TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms compliance with the Provincial IT Board (PITB) RFP requirements for “PITB ICMS – District Case Management,” including submission instructions (separate technical/financial proposals, required copies/media, and no email submission) and adherence to the stated deadlines for submission and written clarifications.

Eligibility and governance: We are an SECP-incorporated private limited company, established in 2012, satisfying the “minimum five (5) years” SECP registration requirement. [CO-PROFILE] We will provide the required affidavit confirming no conflict of interest with PITB officials as part of the bid submission.

Quality and information security: We hold valid ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, meeting the mandatory QMS and ISMS requirements. [CO-PROFILE]

Relevant delivery experience (PARTIAL): Our evidence library shows multiple completed, large-scale deployments in government and enterprise environments above PKR 50,000,000, including Cloud Infrastructure (PKR 108M) [CAP-012], LMS Development (PKR 102M) [CAP-046], and Cybersecurity (PKR 178M) [CAP-049]. However, our library does not yet evidence three (3) completed projects explicitly described as district-level case management/workflow systems within the last five years; we will address “similar nature and scale” through solution walkthroughs, architecture mappings, and referenceable delivery artifacts from the cited programs. [CAP-012][CAP-046][CAP-049]

Solution requirements (PARTIAL): We will deliver a web-based system with RBAC, bilingual (English/Urdu) UX, and DR with RTO ≤ 4 hours; our past evidence includes security-certified delivery on cloud/infrastructure programs, but does not explicitly evidence RBAC, Urdu UI, or RTO≤4 in the cited records, so these will be contractually committed and demonstrated during design, UAT, and DR drills. [CAP-012][CO-PROFILE]

Support/SLA and data protection: We will provide the required on-site support and SLA commitments and comply with Provincial Data Protection Guidelines 2024; our ISO 27001-backed ISMS will be applied to citizen data handling. [CO-PROFILE]

Mandatory gap (CISSP/equivalent): Our library does not yet evidence two (2) CISSP-certified (or equivalent) professionals. We will close this prior to contract award by assigning two certified resources via immediate recruitment/contracting and will submit certificates and CVs for PITB approval with the final staffing plan.
